hook: A digital pathology score of TROP2 location in tumor cells predicts who benefits from datopotamab deruxtecan.
hook_turn: predicts who benefits from datopotamab deruxtecan.
summary: A computer-vision method measures how much TROP2 sits on the cell membrane versus the cytoplasm in lung tumor slides. Patients scoring positive had longer progression-free survival on the antibody-drug conjugate (median 7.2 vs 4.0 months) but not on docetaxel. The cut-point was tuned and tested within retrospective analyses of trial samples, so it needs prospective confirmation.
title: Normalized membrane ratio of TROP2 as a predictor of clinical outcomes with datopotamab deruxtecan in non-small-cell lung cancer.
